commits_info.message:
2.14.0 release (previous 2.13.3) + release notes updated by CI build 3201

[ci skip-release]

Merge pull request #1307 from moltmann/ThrowCallable

Fixes #1306: Invocation's real method throws Throwable

Needed to make the new API serializable

Otherwise, non-android use cases like Powermockito, will use the new public API and break when mocks are being serialized. For android use cases we don't need serialization, but this new public API will be used in other context, too.

Updated version because changing public API

Now the version is consistent with Javadoc.
Documentation - emphasized deprecation and explained rationale

Reduced duplication, removed serialVersionUID

serialVersionUID is used inconsistently across the codebase and it is not updated when the class changes internal implementation. Hence, it is not useful at all. We don't have use cases to share serialized state between different versions of Mockito anyway.

Fixes #1306: Invocation's real method throws Throwable

A real method might throw a Throwable, but the invocations produced by
InvocationFactory call the real method via a Callable that can only
throw a Exception.

Hence add a new method to InvocationFactory that allows to create
invocations with a RealMethodBehavior == a Callable that throws a
Throwable.

Update link of Maven Central badge (#1299)

Link to list of mockito-core versions instead of linking to version 2.8.47
